title: Meat And You: Partners In Freedom
description: Troy McClure visits a stockyard and shows how meat gets from the ranch to your stomach.
quote: I was a grade A moron to ever question eating meat!
altHero: Troy McClure, dressed as a cowboy, with a young kid near a pen of cows
alt2: food chain diagram with a bunch of animals just pointing to a human
alt3: McClure with the boy who has a steak on a plate
alt4: the factory is dumping meat into the back of a truck that says “Meat for You”
